related_questions.question: Do I have to go to work if I have COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: In general, it's not recommended to go to work if you have COVID-19. It's best to stay home and away from others to prevent the spread of the virus. California law requires employers to provide paid sick leave for COVID-related absences and to offer COVID testing for employees with close workplace contacts.

list.title: Stay home:
list.snippet: If you test positive for COVID-19, you should stay home and avoid public places, including work, until you meet certain criteria.

list.title: California requirements:
list.snippet: California law mandates that employers provide paid sick leave for COVID-related absences and offer COVID-19 testing to employees who have had close workplace contact.

list.title: When to return:
list.snippet: According to the California Department of Industrial Relations, you can return to work if you have been fever-free for 24 hours, your symptoms are mild and improving, and you haven't developed any new symptoms.
